name: Plan Channel Native Social Content
summary: Plan platform-native social content from audience value, proof, voice, and sustainable operations.
description: Plan, write, repurpose, or review organic social content for a defined audience and platform using original evidence, native formats, voice constraints, moderation, and measurement. Use when a team needs a sustainable social program rather than generic cross-posting.
refuses: It does not publish, schedule, reply, or contact users without explicit authorization.
It does not plagiarize creators, fabricate engagement, hide sponsorship, or exploit private conversations.
It does not promise virality, follower growth, or revenue from posting frequency.
